decision_rule: KEEP rotated iff (a) rot-AR corrected-MSE < current baseline MSE AND (b) rot-AR low-band retention >= current retention (same t/band defs as tail_fidelity_autoround.json); fused parents decided at whole-module granularity (mixed parent -> whole parent deselected).
fused_rule_basis: vLLM compressed_tensors transform/linear.py: get_linear_transform_schemes assigns per-partition input_tfms; _validate_tfm_schemes raises ValueError('Must have same input') on mismatch; a single input transform wraps the whole fused module input, so partial targeting is invalid.
spec_deviations: The 12 plain linear_attn in_proj tensors were NOT holding current baseline weights in rot-patch-AR as the task spec assumed: they hold AutoRound option-A re-quantized weights (verified byte-difference vs baseline and via mse_table_ar.json optionA vs optionB). Since option-A loses on BOTH corrected MSE (+12..24% worse) and low-band retention, they were restored to baseline under the same decision rule (fused in_proj_qkvz parents uniformly deselected).
